features: ENx Technology: Enjoy calls with high clarity indoors or on the go with the boAt Airdopes Beat TWS Earbuds. ENx-powered mics cancel background noise so you won’t have to search for a quiet spot
13 mm Drivers: Disconnect from the chaos with punchy audio from the 13mm drivers which transport you to the audio realm. Feel the highs, mids, and lows of your playlist to the fullest!
35 hours of Playtime: Plug in your Airdopes and dive into audio entertainment for up to 35 hours. Binge-watch the new OTT content or tune into your favorite podcast without frequent charging woes
Low Latency: Say goodbye to lag as you game with up to 50 ms low latency of BEAST mode. With Airdopes Beat, the winning spot is yours!
Bluetooth v5.4: Whether you are on the go or chilling at home, Bluetooth v5.4 wireless audio lets you unwind wirelessly
ASAP Charge: Charge your earbuds for 10 minutes and resume entertainment for 120 minutes. Be it web series or movies, you can enjoy binge-watching with ASAP Charge!
IPX4 Splash and Sweat Resistance: Pop in your earbuds and relax to music at the gym, beach, and pool. IPX4 water resistance keeps sweat and splash away for uninterrupted fun
